title: SomaticRouterResult
description: Classification of a Feldenkrais lesson across the five VL Frameworks

classifications.description: Weighted scores (0.0-1.0) for each VL framework

vl1_vertical_self.description: VL-1: Focus on gravity, skeletal columns, longitudinal force transmission

vl2_homunculus.description: VL-2: Focus on micro-differentiation, joint resolution, sensory mapping

vl3_steering.description: VL-3: Focus on eyes, jaw, neck, autonomic regulation

vl4_proximal_distal.description: VL-4: Focus on limb-to-core power transmission, reach, grasp

vl5_folding.description: VL-5: Focus on flexion/extension, abdominal release, protective reflexes

primary_framework.description: The dominant framework for this lesson

indicator.description: Specific element from the lesson that indicates this framework

key_indicators.description: Specific lesson elements that informed the classification
